subject: Updating a Data Frame with User-input Values for use in Predict()

messages.author: 0aa92250ba9837bd
messages.subject: Updating a Data Frame with User-input Values for use in Predict()
parts:
I have a web app that takes a stored randomForest() model and updates it with user-input values.

It should then run `predict()` with the updated dataframe and model object.

I'm able to display the updated dataframe in my UI with no problem, which I've been doing as a troubleshooting step. However, whenever I try to use the dataframe with `predict()` it leads to an error. The current and longest-running error that I've been getting is

Error: variables in the training data missing in newdata
However, I'm pretty sure that the problem is not simply a difference in the column names, because:
  1. I can see that they are the same
  2. I can run setdiff() and confirm that they match
  3. The column names and dataframe in general is just a direct (updated) subset of the training dataframe
  4. When trying various changes to the code I get different errors or, in some cases, the results simply do no appear

You can see what I've been trying at this Stackoverflow post. There's also a link to both a minimal reproducible version of the problem and of the entire working version of my project.

http://stackoverflow.com/questions/27909898/errors-in-using-predict-with-randomforest-in-shiny

Minimal, reproducible example: https://github.com/hack-r/troubleshooting_predictor_minimal

Here's the full reproducible code and data: https://github.com/hack-r/coursera_shiny
